- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.5) — reduce forecast by 2–5% for 30-day horizon.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.3) — add 2–5% to forecast for 30-day horizon.
- Overshoot after recent spikes — cap forecast at 10–15% below peak if sentiment turns neutral or bearish.
- Mean-reversion bias: if 30d forecast is > 10% above recent 10-day average, adjust down by 1–3%.
- Lagged sentiment effect: if sentiment was high 2–3 days prior, forecast should be slightly lower than model output.
- Horizon-specific: 30d forecasts tend to overreact to short-term sentiment — apply smoothing filter (e.g., 5-day moving average) to reduce volatility.
